title: Redeliver pre-archive task outcome reporting
outOfScope: Rebasing, merging, rewriting, or deleting the archived-unmerged RFE-104 evidence or pull request.
Claiming that a machine can authenticate the human recipient of a chat report.

sources.reason: Current finish lifecycle and active Outcome integration boundary.
Current deterministic Task Outcome rendering boundary.
Executable regression coverage for pre-archive Outcome behavior.
Authoritative serial plan and RFE-104 successor-only recovery requirement.
Records why the archived, unmerged RFE-104 branch must be redelivered by a fresh successor.

rawUserRequest: Every Work Item must report its Outcome directly in the current conversation after ai-finish and before archive, in the language of the conversation; the user has continuing authorization to proceed through the planned lifecycle without a confirmation stop.

declaredIntent.summary: Redeliver the pre-archive direct human Task Outcome reporting boundary on current main without reviving the blocked predecessor branch.

riskAssessment.reason: A premature archive or file-only report prevents a human from reviewing the active Work Item; lifecycle changes must preserve fail-closed archive and PR evidence. The repository cannot cryptographically prove that a particular human received, read, or approved a chat report; this is a documented limitation, not an open unknown.

executionDecision.reason: The user granted continuing authorization for planned Work Items; the implementation remains bounded to the active-report lifecycle.

preReviewWarnings: Review the exact order: ai-finish succeeds, a direct Outcome is available while the Work Item remains active, and archive/PR/closure remain separate later steps.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: ai-finish generates and reports a concise Task Outcome while Contract, Summary, and Outcome are still active; it does not archive, commit, push, create a PR, merge, close, or delete branches.
The direct Outcome contains delivery, verification, risks and next lifecycle state, and is renderable in English, Chinese, and Japanese according to the current conversation language boundary.
Archive requires an explicit human-confirmed transition after the active Outcome, while continuing plan authorization can drive the separately authorized archive/PR lifecycle.
Template and installed Runtime entrypoints preserve the same pre-archive Outcome boundary.
Regression coverage proves successful active reporting, failed verification staying active, multilingual rendering, installer parity, and no automatic archive side effect.
Traceability, capability truth, Japanese assessment, and documentation alignment state the bounded behavior without claiming chat identity authentication.
guidelines: Keep user-visible reports distinct from machine-readable evidence and surface the report directly in the conversation.
Do not treat continuing execution authority as evidence that a particular human reviewed an Outcome.
Preserve the canonical archive → PR → merge → closure sequence after the active reporting point.

intent.problem: Prior Outcome artifacts existed only as files and the blocked predecessor could not be merged because its delayed archive evidence collided with newer records. A human needs a direct, active-state report before irreversible archive transitions.
constraints: Implement from current origin/main; do not revive, rebase, or modify RFE-104 archived evidence.
Do not weaken quality, archive, PR, coverage, or lifecycle gates.
Keep reports language-aligned with the human conversation but never claim language output authenticates identity or approval.
intent.rationale: Direct active-state reporting makes human review possible before archive while preserving machine evidence and the established one-Work-Item lifecycle.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A successful code Work Item reaches ai-finish.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A direct active Outcome is generated before archive and the Work Item remains active.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise ai-finish integration tests and inspect no archive side effect.

scenarioCoverage.expected: No success Outcome, archive, PR, or closure is reported; active evidence remains available for repair.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The conversation language is English, Chinese, or Japanese.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The deterministic Outcome view uses the corresponding supported presentation language without translating arbitrary evidence prose.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The Runtime is installed into an adopter project.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The installed Make entrypoint retains the pre-archive Outcome boundary.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise installer and adopter lifecycle regression coverage.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User granted continuing authorization for planned process corrections; approval is limited to the scoped Makefile, template Runtime, policy, and governance evidence updates.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
